verdict.rationale: Docs confirm native iOS, Android, and React Native SDKs (with Flutter coming) plus SDK-token-based capture flow (docs-2,3,22), and a web-based no-code 'Smart Capture Link' alternative (docs-7), but no evidence explicitly describes real-time glare, blur, or edge-detection coaching guiding users to a usable photo. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of in-SDK image-quality coaching (glare/blur/edge detection), confirmation of a dedicated JS/web SDK (vs. hosted link), and any hands-on/independent corroboration of capture UX quality.
